summary: Frees a dynamically-allocated child object held at this+0x50 when non-null. Reads the pointer this[20] (this+0x50); if it is non-null, calls EmptyStub_0170 (no-op) and then returns FreeWrapper_7bcf(child), otherwise falls through to return an uninitialized result. Existing analysis places this on the SpecialFX_Post cleanup path.

operations.description: Read the child-object pointer stored at this[20] (byte offset this+0x50) into a local.
Guard on the child pointer being non-null: only when it is non-null does the cleanup path run; a null pointer falls through to the final return.
Call EmptyStub_0170, a no-op stub invoked immediately before the free.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf(child) to release the child object from the heap and return its result.
Return the FreeWrapper_7bcf result when the child was non-null; the null branch returns an uninitialized result (Hex-Rays artifact).
